newsitem.title: UK: ICI taps stg for first time in nine years.
newsitem.headline: ICI taps stg for first time in nine years.

text.p: An Imperial Chemical Industries Plc launch of a 300 million stg 10-year bond met with an enthusiastic response from the market, ICI said in a statement on Wednesday.
The bond was priced to yield 70 basis points over the 10-year gilt.
Joint lead managers BZW and NatWest Markets saw demand primarily from British institutions, as well as investors in Asia and Europe, the statement said.
The proceeds from the Eurobond will be used to pay down bank borrowings raised in connection with the recent acquisition by ICI of the Speciality Chemicals Businesses of Unilever Plc.
The issue is launched under ICI's new Euro Medium Term Note programme, rated A-/Baa1 by S&P and Moody's respectively.

"By taking advantage of attractive bond market conditions we have been able to refinance an additional element of our recent Speciality Chemicals acquisition," Alan Spall, ICI's Chief Financial Officer said in the statement.
"This will further reduce ICI's cost of finance as well as lengthen the maturity profile of our borrowings," he added.
This is ICI's first sterling denominated Eurobond in nine years and follows ICI's $500 million dollar five-year bond launched last week.
